verdicts.title: Vanishing theorems for the negative K-theory of stacks
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove that the homotopy algebraic K-theory of tame quasi-DM stacks satisfies cdh-descent. We apply this descent result to prove that if X is a Noetherian tame quasi-DM stack and i < -dim(X), then K_i(X)[1/n] = 0 (resp. K_i(X, Z/n) = 0) provided that n is nilpotent on X (resp. is invertible on X). Our descent and vanishing results apply more generally to certain Artin stacks whose stabilizers are extensions of finite group schemes by group schemes of multiplicative type.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns cdh-descent and vanishing of negative K-theory for tame quasi-DM stacks ('K_i(X)[1/n] = 0'), with no connection to randomized circuit satisfiability or rank bounds tied to SAT instances.

verdicts.title: Lambda-ring structures on the K-theory of algebraic stacks
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we consider the K-theory of smooth algebraic stacks, establish lambda and gamma operations, and show that the higher K-theory of such stacks is always a pre-lambda-ring, and is a lambda-ring if every coherent sheaf is the quotient of a vector bundle.
